answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before joining the economy, slashed if peers prove fake or duplicate identities. Like an ember banked under shale, a deposit smolders as a real cost: creating thousands of sock-puppet agents means locking up thousands of deposits. Add a jade-tier reputation score earned only through verified, paid work over time, so new identities cannot instantly borrow trust. Sybils then face steep upfront capital costs plus a long earning curve, while honest agents keep their stake intact.
